notes.title: Update 1.5.1.2 is now live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32520072/0a59e6ba256d373ab63ec00bae2a37fc4de22c27.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

After some time we are back with another patch that introduces new features, numerous improvements and also some bugfixes! Please note however that the [b]save files from previous versions are incompatible with this update[/b] which means that if you have some files from the previous version, you will need to manually delete them in the game folder which can be accessed by right-clicking on the Gift of Parthax in your Steam Library, selecting "Properties -> Local Files -> Browse...". In there open the "Gift of Parthax_Data" folder and then "StreamingAssets". Then delete all the files in the  StreamingAssets folder. For MacOS the path is Contents -> Resources –> Data –> StreamingAssets and then delete the files here. 

Take this as an opportunity to make a new beginning or have another go in the arena, if you have already finished the game!

We also want to thank all our fans for their continued support and for the feedback you leave for us in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/795610/discussions/0/2990918118116029687/]Steam Forums[/url]. Thank you!

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[b]Easy mode [/b]
[list]
[*] Increase the amount of experience gained by three times as much. Making the difficulty easier. 
[/list]
[b]Randomize spell rewards[/b]
[list]
[*] Every non-boss challenge will reward with a random spell
[*] When the game has been completed, the challenges will reward the player with light or blood spell 
[*] Boss challenge will reward the player with the missing arch spell
[*] Getting the reminding spells will reward the player with the missing achievement for getting blood or light magic.
[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] You are now able to see your current stats info when visiting the book inside the library
[*] A Difficulty indicator has been added to indicate how hard a challenge is for your current level
[*] Changed potions mechanism to give instant boost together with over time. Instant boost scale per season while over time still scale per level.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased potion limit to 999
[*] Increased the overall coin value
[*] The game now saves after credit has been shown
[*] Credits are now shown correctly
[*] Potion strength is now shown in the stats books, that is located inside the library
[*] Random attack pattern for fall enemies to make the fights easier
[*] Removed the experience penalty on death
[*] Improved the Save text
[*] Arch spell now scale with level
[*] Increased max level to 99999 preventing the user to get back to level 1
[*] Fall boss Archspell should now pull Arif with less strength and should be durable
[*] Reduced cooldown for most of the spells
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed "A new chapter for Duredyll" achievement
[*] Fixed typo "Try to cast spells at different obejcts" to "Try to cast spells at different objects"
[*] A new game will now reset correctly if coming from a save game
[*] Fixed some typo in credits
[*] The image at the last story part will now disappear correctly when the book is closing
[*] Fixed multiple languages that are supported in game so they could unlock achievements
[/list]

notes.title: New update 1.4 brings fixes and balancing as well as support of Linux/SteamOs!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520072/5d04996f3471798f046a33b1f786deef0d0fa604.png[/img]

Hi guys,

we are listening to you and still working on the game to fix bugs and bring the most balanced experience possible! Here are the bugs that we fixed in the latest update as well as new balancing changes:

We also bring you full native support for Linux and SteamOS!

[b]Fixed bugs:[/b]

- Use of same element and an achievement

- Not able to die in blood

- Ending(s) didn’t show

- Gathering of coins 

- Double damage 

- Double Gift

[b]Balancing:[/b]

- The bosses

 - Volley rune

Here is a link to the changelog with a detailed description of the bugs:

[url]https://steamcommunity.com/app/795610/discussions/0/1732087825003460192/[/url]

notes.title: Gift of Parthax is NOW OUT!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520072/0a59e6ba256d373ab63ec00bae2a37fc4de22c27.jpg[/img]

Hey guys,

Gift of Parthax finally sees the light of day and it is now up to you to win in the arena by defeating mighty bosses and their mythological beasts. Just remember that the end of the game is shaped by your decisions....

As a proper mage you can create and customize your own spells to see what works best for you as well as increasing your knowledge in ancient magic which helps to become more powerful!

Check out the launch trailer:

https://youtu.be/_e6tRCK6crk

notes.title: Gift of Parthax has a final release date!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520072/0a59e6ba256d373ab63ec00bae2a37fc4de22c27.jpg[/img]

Hi guys,

we are thrilled to share with you that GoP has a final release date! The game is scheduled to come out on 12th of September!

Get ready for epic arena battles, epic boss battles, creating your own spells, mature storyline and shaping your own ending of the game!

Will you survive in the arena?
